description: A user submitted a known phishing URL to an AI application.

alert_titles: Phishing attempt detected in an AI application

notes: Missing provider content must be reported as an evidence gap, not interpreted as benign activity.
platform: Microsoft Defender for Cloud AI workloads
questions: What principal initiated or received the AI interaction?
What exact content entered the model or agent context?
Did the alerting control audit, detect, or block the activity?
What model/agent/tool action followed the suspicious event?
Did any consequence escape the AI boundary?
What independent identity, endpoint, network, cloud, or target-system evidence corroborates impact?
title: Phishing attempt detected in an AI application
